template: In Odoo (already signed in as admin), open the Sales app and create a NEW quotation. In the Customer field, type '{{v2}}' and select the matching option from the autocomplete dropdown that appears (the value only counts if chosen from the dropdown). Then in the Order Lines table add exactly ONE order line: pick any product from the product catalogue by typing in the Product field and choosing an option from the autocomplete dropdown, and set its Quantity to 3. Do NOT add any other lines. Save the quotation (it stays a draft quotation, do not confirm). Then report: (a) the product name you chose, (b) the Unit Price the app filled in for that line, and (c) the Untaxed Amount the app computes for the quotation. Read these values from the saved quotation page.
